name: Caraffa di Catanzaro (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Caraffa di Catanzaro (a black eagle on red) within branches, with the inscription AMMINISTRAZIONE COMUNALE CARAFFA DI CATANZARO in dark red beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Caraffa di Catanzaro, a comune in Calabria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Caraffa di Catanzaro arms — black eagle on red, crowned, within branches
inscription AMMINISTRAZIONE COMUNALE CARAFFA DI CATANZARO beneath the arms
